overview_description.description:
UrbanKisaan Agricultural Intelligence is a venture-backed agtech company building the world’s first full-stack Agricultural Intelligence platform. Our mission is to transform the $300B+ global seed and nutrient markets by drastically accelerating crop development and delivering AI-powered, precision farming solutions.

Through proprietary platforms like GeneRush (4x faster seed development), URBI (autonomous phenomics rover), and FarmOS (chat-based AI SaaS for farm management), we offer scalable, data-driven solutions for climate-resilient agriculture. Our full-stack approach—from AI-driven seed breeding to satellite-based soil monitoring—unlocks new efficiencies for seed companies, input suppliers, and governments.

We’ve filed 7 proprietary crop lines, with 15+ in development, and operate in 15 countries.

UrbanKisaan is uniquely positioned at the intersection of biotech, AI, and automation—backed by a seasoned team of scientists, engineers, and agri-entrepreneurs. We’re not just improving agriculture—we’re rebuilding its intelligence infrastructure.

about_short_description.short_description: UrbanKisaan offers full-stack agricultural intelligence to accelerate seed development, farm automation & AI-driven crop optimization.

product.name: Vertical Hydroponic Farming Systems
product.description: Soil-less, fully automated systems for growing crops in controlled environments such as warehouses, shipping containers, indoors, rooftops, and open land.

product.name: Speed Breeding Program
product.description: A program that uses extended photoperiods, controlled temperatures, optimized light quality, and intensity to accelerate plant growth and reduce generation times for crops like Okra, Tomato, and Rice.

product.name: Proprietary Seeds and Formulations
product.description: Custom seeds and nutrient formulations designed for hydroponics and vertical farming, enabling more nutritious, pest-resistant, and disease-resistant crops.

product.name: Hydroponics and Vertical Farming Training
product.description: Training provided to customers on setting up and managing hydroponic and vertical farms, including site approval, farm delivery logistics, and launch activities.

product.name: Technical Support
product.description: Ongoing support from a specialized team for customers who purchase a farm, including a dedicated representative for continuous communication.

product.name: Online Community and Marketing Support
product.description: Access to an exclusive online forum for connecting with other farmers, and marketing support from UrbanKisaan's team for business and marketing needs.
